headline: U.S. Consumer Sentiment Holds at 48.0 as Buying Conditions Weaken
summary: The University of Michigan reported consumer sentiment at 48.0, dropping 0.1 points as households expressed pessimism regarding durable goods and home purchases.
why: Consumer sentiment surveys are leading indicators for retail spending trends and overall economic resilience in the United States.

impacts.name: Retail
impacts.why: Pessimistic consumer purchasing conditions often precede subdued discretionary retail sales.
